UMLGenVertions.description: Initial stable release for Windows. Includes core UML diagram generation, basic class parsing, and JSON rule support.
Early Linux port of version 1.0.0. Contains core features but lacks full UI integration and performance optimizations.
Bug fix update improving parsing accuracy and fixing UI crashes when handling large UML diagrams.
Experimental prototype build. Limited functionality and unstable parsing system. No longer supported.
First macOS release with full diagram rendering support and native UI compatibility.
Major Linux update adding improved performance, multi-threaded parsing, and better file handling.
Beta macOS build introducing plugin support and experimental real-time diagram updates.
Early development build with minimal features and incomplete parsing logic. Deprecated.
Major release introducing modular rule engine, advanced syntax recognition, and improved UI/UX.
Stable Linux release of version 2.0.0 with full feature parity and optimized memory usage.
Preview build with live diagram editing, improved node linking, and partial AI-assisted structure detection.
Stable patch improving performance of large-scale diagrams and fixing memory leaks.
Experimental macOS version with redesigned UI and advanced export options (SVG, PDF, JSON).
Stable Linux build adding plugin marketplace support and enhanced scripting capabilities.
Next-gen beta featuring AI-assisted UML generation, automatic refactoring suggestions, and cloud sync.
macOS beta for version 3.0.0 with AI-assisted diagram creation and collaborative editing tools.
